tools.name: search_sounds
tools.description: Free-text search over the SFXMint library of free CC0 sound effects. Use it for sound descriptions, additional constraints or gaps left by another tool. Choose get_role_sound for a named event or get_sound_set for multiple events when that fits the task; these are task branches, not a fixed sequence

tools.name: get_sound
tools.description: Get full metadata for one sound by slug, including download URLs, description and acoustics measured from the WAV (silence before the sound, where it peaks, audible length, attack, tail, brightness, levels, character labels).

tools.name: check_connect
tools.description: After a download was refused with a connect link and code (download_limit without a key) and the user says they connected: returns api_key once they pressed Connect, made on their free account. Call it once after their reply, not in a loop: while status is pending, show them the link and code again

tools.description: Make an individual sound effect from a description when the library has nothing suitable (search_sounds has no full match and its closest sounds do not suit). tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Check a generation started with generate_sound, generate_ambience, generate_music or change_sound: status, kind and fresh download links for the finished takes, including loop_url when a loop was made.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_picks" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_connect" references sensitive artifacts (.env, api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
